x: Next for us came Syd Ring, striving to put every second possible between himself and the following men; then Bert Cook, the evergreen; and "Mick" Walker.

"Mick" Walker and "Snaky" Webb, whose dancing reputations are far-flung, should play opposite one another, more often if possible. Ring, the Ruthless, gave a great exhibition of Eastern passion in contrast to his partner, Cecil Penny, who danced with utter abandon.
